The '''Imperial Action transport''', also simply called an '''Imperial transport''', was a model of [[Bulk freighter/Legends|heavy freighter]] [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==

Imperial Action transports were equipped with six [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]]: two permanently mounted at the aft, and four that could rotate vertically to facilitate landing. It was also equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

For self-defense, the transport was armed with two forward-facing laser cannons. Its large cargo bay could accommodate mechanized units such as [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PTs]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]],<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" /> [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> and Imperial [[Armored Personnel Carrier|APCs]],<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" /> deployable via boarding ramps at both the aft<ref name="TCSWE" /> and bow. In addition to vehicles, these freighters transported infantry such as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], as well as [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

When operating in low-light conditions, the transport used four spotlights, two at the front and two at the back, to illuminate its landing zone.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Alright boys, after those Imperial transports!|Luke Skywalker during the Attack on Yavin 4|<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />}}
[[File:Rebelstrike_092403_x1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Imperial Action transports landing on Yavin 4]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" /> the [[Galactic Empire]] deployed Imperial Action transports during its [[Attack on Yavin 4|retaliatory ground assault]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

While the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were evacuating the last of its [[Alliance High Command/Legends|command staff]] from the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], with the assistance of fellow [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] pilots [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Sarkli|Sarkli]], destroyed eight Action transports carrying ground reinforcements.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

The Imperial Action transport remained in service throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Imperial officer [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] defected to the Alliance on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], he was captured by the Empire and nearly transported offworld in an Action transport before Red Squadron [[Mission to Dantooine|intervened]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

During the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|Imperial Blockade]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], Imperial Action transports were used to unload ground reinforcements during a [[Defense of Ralltiir|Rebel mission to rescue scientists]] affiliated with the Alliance.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Bakura">The [[Raid at Bakura|raid at Bakura]] follows the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Imperial Action transports were used to transport Rebel prisoners away from the [[Bakura Imperial Prison|Imperial holding facility]] orbiting [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], utilizing [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-Wings]], [[Raid at Bakura|disabled the transports]] with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], allowing [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] [[Rescue 1 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 1'']], [[Rescue 2 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 2'']], and [[Rescue 3 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 3'']] to offload the prisoners.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

Before the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Dubrillion]], Rogue Squadron encountered a convoy of Imperial Action transports [[Mission to Destrillion|being escorted]] near [[Destrillion|Destrillion]] by [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunters]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The main targets are these large Imperial landers that are really cool designs by Paul Topolos.|Jamie Uhrmacher in the audio commentary for ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''|<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />}}
Created by [[Paul Topolos]] for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', the Imperial Action transport was designed to be very recognizable and serve as a large target for new players. In design, Imperial Action transports resembled vessels in the [[Action series/Legends|Action series]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />
